# Libraries

```{r}
# Load libraries 

library(FLCore)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)

library(rjags)
library(loo)
library(bayesplot)
library(shinystan)

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 16))
```

# Data preparation

```{r}
# load object from WGHANSA 2022
load(file.path("..","data","aneq.stk.RData")) # aneq.stk

# remove 2023

aneq.stk <- window(aneq.stk, end=2022)

# recruitment (1st January)
# change units

rec <- rec(aneq.stk)
rec <- rec*1e-6
units(rec) <- "1e9"

# ssb (from FLBiols because it is the same as used in FLBEIA)

aneq.biol <- as(aneq.stk, "FLBiol")
ssb <- ssb(aneq.biol)
# equivalently, (i.e. without fishing mortality)
# quantSums(stock.n(aneq.stk)*exp(-m(aneq.stk)*m.spwn(aneq.stk))*stock.wt(aneq.stk)*mat(aneq.stk))
ssb <- ssb/1000
units(ssb) <- "1000 t"

# create data frame

df <- data.frame(year=as.numeric(dimnames(aneq.stk)$year), 
                 rec=as.numeric(rec), 
                 ssb=as.numeric(ssb))

# create log variables

df <- df %>% 
  mutate(logr=log(rec),
         logssb=log(ssb),
         rat=rec/ssb, 
         lograt=log(rat))

dat <- read.csv(file.path("..","data","env_data.csv"), sep=",")

df <- left_join(df, dat)
df <- subset(df, select=-c(date)) # remove the date column (which is a character)
names(df)
```

# Fit Ricker SR model 

```{r}
# write data to a txt file

dat <- list(
  n=nrow(df), 
  rec=df$rec, 
  ssb=df$ssb, 
  mu.logalpha=-1.7, psi.logalpha=1, 
  mu.logbeta=-5, psi.logbeta=1,
  a.psi=1, b.psi=0.07)

# initial values

#inits <- NULL  # this would be without fixing the seed
inits <- list(.RNG.name = "base::Wichmann-Hill", .RNG.seed = 1234) # fixing the seed and the random number generator

# list of parameters to be saved
# to compute LOO and WAIC, we have to add the loglik per observation in the JAGS model and in the tracked parameters

param0 <- c("logalpha","logbeta","alpha","beta","psi") # model parameters (without/with transformation)
param <- c(param0, "loglik", "resid", "logrhat")

# path for the JAGS model

model.path <- file.path("..","jags_models","ricker_jags.txt")

# MCMC specifications

n.chains <- 3
n.adapt <- 5000
n.burnin <- 100000
n.thin <- 100
n.iter <- 500000 

# model fit

ptm.ini <- Sys.time()
print(Sys.time())
m <- jags.model(model.path, dat=dat, inits=inits, n.chains=n.chains, n.adapt=n.adapt)
print(Sys.time())

# burn-in

print(Sys.time())
update(m, n.iter=n.burnin)
print(Sys.time())

# coda object with MCMC

run.mcmc <- coda.samples(m, variable.names=param, n.iter=n.iter, thin=n.thin)
ptm.end <- Sys.time()
ptm <- ptm.end - ptm.ini
print(ptm)

# compute DIC

dic.mcmc <- dic.samples(m, variable.names=param, n.iter=n.iter, thin=n.thin)
dic.mcmc

# compute loo and waic

loglik.mcmc <- as.matrix(run.mcmc[,grep("loglik", varnames(run.mcmc))])
waic.value <- waic(loglik.mcmc)
waic.value$estimates
loo.value <- loo(loglik.mcmc)
loo.value$estimates

# summary statistics 

summary(run.mcmc[, param0])

# standard plot

plot(run.mcmc[, param0])

# diagnostics using library coda

gelman.diag(run.mcmc[, param0])
gelman.plot(run.mcmc[, param0])
geweke.diag(run.mcmc[, param0])
geweke.plot(run.mcmc[, param0])
heidel.diag(run.mcmc[, param0])
raftery.diag(run.mcmc[, param0])
effectiveSize(run.mcmc[, param0])

# plots using library coda

autocorr.diag(run.mcmc[, param0])
autocorr.plot(run.mcmc[, param0], ask=F)
crosscorr.plot(run.mcmc[, param0], ask=F)
crosscorr(run.mcmc[, param0])
cumuplot(run.mcmc[, param0], ask=F)
densplot(run.mcmc[, param0], ask=F)
traceplot(run.mcmc[, param0], ask=F)

# convert to matrix and then to data.frame to extract posterior values

run.post <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(run.mcmc))

# vector of quantiles to use to get the credible intervals and the estimates

qvec <- c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)

# statistics of the prior distributions

qnorm(qvec, dat$mu.logalpha, 1/sqrt(dat$psi.logalpha))
qnorm(qvec, dat$mu.logbeta, 1/sqrt(dat$psi.logbeta))
qgamma(qvec, dat$a.psi, dat$b.psi)

# prior-posterior

xmin <- min(qnorm(c(0.025, 0.975), dat$mu.logalpha, sqrt(1/dat$psi.logalpha)), run.post$logalpha)
xmax <- max(qnorm(c(0.025, 0.975), dat$mu.logalpha, sqrt(1/dat$psi.logalpha)), run.post$logalpha)
x <- seq(xmin, xmax, length=10000)
y <- density(run.post$logalpha, bw=(xmax-xmin)/20)
yprior <- dnorm(x, dat$mu.logalpha, sqrt(1/dat$psi.logalpha))
ymin  <- min(y$y, yprior)
ymax  <- max(y$y, yprior)
plot(y, lwd=2, xlim=c(xmin, xmax), ylim=c(ymin, ymax), xlab="", ylab="", main=expression(ln(alpha)), yaxt="n", cex.main=2.5, cex.lab=1.5, cex.axis=1.5)
lines(x, yprior, lty=2, lwd=2)

xmin <- min(qnorm(c(0.025, 0.975), dat$mu.logbeta, sqrt(1/dat$psi.logbeta)), run.post$logbeta)
xmax <- max(qnorm(c(0.025, 0.975), dat$mu.logbeta, sqrt(1/dat$psi.logbeta)), run.post$logbeta)
x <- seq(xmin, xmax, length=10000)
y <- density(run.post$logbeta, bw=(xmax-xmin)/20)
yprior <- dnorm(x, dat$mu.logbeta, sqrt(1/dat$psi.logbeta))
ymin  <- min(y$y, yprior)
ymax  <- max(y$y, yprior)
plot(y, lwd=2, xlim=c(xmin, xmax), ylim=c(ymin, ymax), xlab="", ylab="", main=expression(ln(beta)), yaxt="n", cex.main=2.5, cex.lab=1.5, cex.axis=1.5)
lines(x, yprior, lty=2, lwd=2)

xmin <- min(qgamma(c(0.025, 0.975), dat$a.psi, dat$b.psi), run.post$psi)
xmax <- max(qgamma(c(0.025, 0.975), dat$a.psi, dat$b.psi), run.post$psi)
x <- seq(xmin, xmax, length=10000)
y <- density(run.post$psi, bw=(xmax-xmin)/20)
yprior <- dgamma(x, dat$a.psi, dat$b.psi)
ymin  <- min(y$y, yprior)
ymax  <- max(y$y, yprior)
ymin <- 0
plot(y, lwd=2, xlim=c(xmin, xmax), ylim=c(ymin, ymax), xlab="", ylab="", main=expression(psi), yaxt="n", cex.main=2.5, cex.lab=1.5, cex.axis=1.5)
lines(x, yprior, lwd=2, lty=2)

# residuals

tmp <- run.post[, paste0("resid[",1:length(df$rec),"]")]
boxplot(tmp)
abline(h=0, col=2)

# additional plots using library bayesplot
# see also: https://mc-stan.org/bayesplot/articles/visual-mcmc-diagnostics.html

# mcmc_trace(run.mcmc)
# mcmc_dens(run.mcmc)

# additional plots using library shinystan
# launch_shinystan(as.shinystan(run.mcmc))

# predicted recruitment series 

tmp <- run.post[,paste0("logrhat[",1:nrow(df),"]")]
tmp <- gather(tmp) %>% 
  mutate(key=ordered(key, levels=paste0("logrhat[",1:nrow(df),"]"))) %>% 
  group_by(key) %>% 
  summarize(med = quantile(exp(value), probs = 0.50),
          low = quantile(exp(value), probs = 0.05),
          up = quantile(exp(value), probs = 0.95)) %>% 
  mutate(year=df$year)

p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(year, med))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=low, ymax=up), fill="grey", alpha=0.5)+
  geom_line(col=1)+
  geom_point(data=df, aes(x=year, y=rec))+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("Recruits (age 0)")+
  expand_limits(y=0)
p

# predicted log recruitment series 

tmp <- run.post[,paste0("logrhat[",1:nrow(df),"]")]
tmp <- gather(tmp) %>% 
  mutate(key=ordered(key, levels=paste0("logrhat[",1:nrow(df),"]"))) %>% 
  group_by(key) %>% 
  summarize(med = quantile(value, probs = 0.50),
          low = quantile(value, probs = 0.05),
          up = quantile(value, probs = 0.95)) %>% 
  mutate(year=df$year)

p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(year, med))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=low, ymax=up), fill="grey", alpha=0.5)+
  geom_line(col=1)+
  geom_point(data=df, aes(x=year, y=logr))+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("Log Recruits (age 0)")+
  expand_limits(y=0)
p

# predicted SR model

pred.dat <- data.frame(ssb=seq(0, max(df$ssb), length=1000))

out <- NULL
for (i in 1:nrow(pred.dat)){
  tmp <- exp(run.post$logalpha) * pred.dat$ssb[i] * exp(-exp(run.post$logbeta) * pred.dat$ssb[i])
  out <- rbind(out, quantile(tmp, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))) 
}
out <- as.data.frame(out)
out <- cbind(pred.dat$ssb, out)
names(out) <- c("ssb","low","med","up")

p <- ggplot(out, aes(x=ssb, y=med))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=low, ymax=up), fill="grey", alpha=0.5)+
  geom_line(lwd=1)+
  geom_point(data=df, aes(x=ssb, y=rec))+
  xlab("SSB")+
  ylab("Recruits (age 0)")+
  expand_limits(x=0, y=0)
p

# give specific name

run.mcmc.rick <- run.mcmc
dic.rick <- dic.mcmc
loglik.rick <-loglik.mcmc
waic.rick <- waic.value
loo.rick <- loo.value
```
